article.title: Presentment of instrument payable on demand.
article.content: Subject to the provisions of section 31, a negotiable instrument payable on demand must be presented for payment within a reasonable time after it is received by the holder.
article.html:
74Presentment of instrument payable on demand.

Section 74 · Chapter V · page 18 of the Act

Subject to the provisions of section 31, a negotiable instrument payable on demand must be presented for payment within a reasonable time after it is received by the holder.
